title: DocumentLocker
tagline: Our application offers a decentralized and secure way to store documents on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. Using blockchain technology and the Sign Protocol, we ensure that all documents are tamper-proof, authenticated, and protected against unauthorized access.
description: Our application leverages the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) to provide a secure, decentralized document storage solution. By utilizing blockchain technology, we ensure that all stored documents are tamper-proof, verifiable, and protected against unauthorized access. Each document is cryptographically signed and verified using the Sign Protocol, which guarantees authenticity and integrity. This enables users to store and manage their important documents with the highest level of security and trust.
how_its_made:
Our application combines modern web development and blockchain technologies for a secure and seamless user experience:

React.js & Vite: We used React.js for the front-end, providing a responsive UI, and Vite for efficient development and fast builds.
Solidity & Ethereum: Solidity smart contracts handle document storage, verification, and user interactions on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring decentralized security.
Sign Protocol: For attestation, the Sign Protocol provides cryptographic signatures to verify the authenticity and integrity of documents.
Hook Smart Contracts: Automates interactions on the blockchain, enabling efficient and secure execution of contract functions.
